narrative: The letter, open. A short letter on a half-sheet, in his hand, the date at the foot. No sum anywhere on it. The private leaf is already face down, off to the side.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Wrote the letter, dated it, and left the sum off.

entities.name: Richard Quiney
entities.context: Written to. Not in the room.

entities.name: Richard Field
entities.context: The promise was his, from Wednesday. Not in the room.

entities.name: the certificate
entities.context: Shown on letter in The certificate
